# What every stream in this directory decompresses to, according to the
# reference Brotli -- google/brotli's own C decoder, run on these bytes.
# This package's decoder must agree with it exactly.
#
# <file> <length in bytes> <sha256 of the output, first 16 hex digits>
#
# Regenerate with:  brotli -d -c f.br | wc -c; brotli -d -c f.br | sha256sum
